WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(fillcount) as global_avg
  FROM orderexecutions
),
first_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    of.ordersmark,
    of.avg_fill
  FROM order_fills of
  CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
  WHERE of.avg_fill > ga.global_avg
),
first_filter_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as filter_avg
  FROM first_filter
),
final_filter AS (
  SELECT 
    ff.ordersmark,
    ff.avg_fill
  FROM first_filter ff
  CROSS JOIN first_filter_avg fa
  WHERE ff.avg_fill > fa.filter_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(ff.avg_fill) as avg_fill_final,
  AVG(ff.avg_fill - ga.global_avg) as margin_vs_global,
  AVG(ff.avg_fill - fa.filter_avg) as margin_vs_filtered
FROM final_filter ff
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
CROSS JOIN first_filter_avg fa
